title: Entry Standing and Holding Limits for Healthy Options Card Programmes
content:
Which Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card a member may be given depends on the standing their profile carries, and how many programmes they may hold at once is capped across the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes as a whole.

| Card tier | Chronic condition the member must have | Extra load for the qualifying chronic condition | Medicaid standing the member must have | Programmes one member may hold at once | Largest total allowance one member may be loaded across every programme in a benefit year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | none | 0.00 USD | none | 2 | 1400.00 USD |
| Select | none | 0.00 USD | none | 2 | 1400.00 USD |
| Plus | none | 0.00 USD | none | 2 | 1400.00 USD |
| Premier | none | 0.00 USD | none | 2 | 1400.00 USD |
| Dual Complete | none | 0.00 USD | qualified Medicare beneficiary, specified low-income beneficiary or full benefit dual | 2 | 1400.00 USD |
| Chronic Care Plus | a qualifying chronic condition from the plan's chronic care list | 125.00 USD | none | 2 | 1400.00 USD |

Every tier also requires that the member holds an active health plan enrollment and that the tier of that health plan carries an allowance.

Two entry standings stand out. The Dual Complete card is open only to a member whose profile carries one of the three Medicaid standings named above. The Chronic Care Plus card is open only to a member with a qualifying chronic condition from the plan's chronic care list, and it is the only tier that carries an extra load for that condition, of 125.00 USD; on the other five that figure is 0.00 USD.

The holding cap of 2 programmes and the combined figure of 1400.00 USD are the same on every tier, so a member holding two cards of different tiers is measured against one cap of 1400.00 USD and not against the sum of two.
